name: @dsh-toolset/md-table-check
description: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）md-table-check 插件：检查回复正文里的 markdown 表格列数是否一致，不一致时经 rule-engine 注入一条汇总提示（只报不改）

scripts.test:coverage: rm -rf ../tmp/cov-md-table-check && mkdir -p ../tmp/cov-md-table-check && NODE_V8_COVERAGE=../tmp/cov-md-table-check node --experimental-transform-types --test 'tests/*.test.ts' 'tests/integration/*.test.ts' && node ../dev/coverage/report.mjs tmp/cov-md-table-check tmp/cov-md-table-check/report.json
